provenance: AI interpretation of actual discovery contribution and conditional residual tables
thesis: Temporary weakness within a positive medium-term trend may improve entry selection over buying the strongest recent winners.

observations.diagnostic: discovery_pullback_diagnostic.csv; overlapping labels averaged by date; exploratory, no significance claim

mechanism: Short-lived selling pressure can reverse while persistent medium-term demand supports the stock. Gap attribution motivates preserving overnight ownership; it does not prove this explanation.
expected_direction: higher next-five-session relative return for positive-trend stocks with a recent pullback
implementation: Equal sum of cross-sectional momentum and reversal ranks; require positive medium-term momentum; equal weight highest 10; rebalance next open every five sessions. No fitted or searched coefficient.
falsification: Reject as an improvement if reused validation net mean does not beat momentum and equal weight at both 5 and 10bps, or if gains are confined to one year/name. Positive results still require prospective evidence because the universe is availability-biased and this is adaptive search.
evidence_status: adaptive discovery follow-up; 2018-2022 reused validation; 2023+ remains sealed
